Design for display at only 128 pixels. Subject motifs: weathered gray stone, warm brown leather bindings, a modest bronze compass crest. Composition: a COMPACT ASYMMETRIC PORTRAIT SURROUND, one bold ornamental crest above and one broad ornament on the LEFT only, a thin broken stone/metal arc below. Right edge must be quiet and short: absolutely NO horizontal health-bar rails, no bar openings, no side sun/endcap, no wide rectangular frame, no face or figure, no text. Square canvas, generous transparent margins. Reserve an EMPTY opening at 60% canvas width and 58% canvas height, approximately 44% of canvas width in diameter. The lower-right quadrant of that opening must be squared outward (Blizzard's teardrop portrait). Keep the rightmost 22% of the canvas empty at portrait height so adjacent health bars have clearance. Keep the lower-left of the portrait opening clear for the small level badge. All art stays compact around the head and left side. Matte hand-painted old game texture, thick contours, roughly hewn forms, limited colors, no glass-like polish, no high-frequency filigree, no high-res CGI. Real transparent alpha background including the portrait opening; do NOT paint checkerboard. ONE Neutral ornament only.
